title: Report out of bounds access to memory that is before the start or after the end of the accessed region (array, heap-allocated region, string literal etc.).
summary: This usually means incorrect indexing, but the checker also detects access via the operators * and ->. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-security.ArrayBound. It applies to C, C++.

title: Reports use of uninitialized (or already released) va_list objects and situations where a va_start call is not followed by va_end.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-security.VAList. It applies to C, C++.

title: Corresponds to SEI CERT Rules ENV31-C and ENV34-C.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-security.cert.env.InvalidPtr.
